test_title: PYST 63: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

We should not __underestimate the signification__ of female education.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect usage of the word "**signification**" instead of "**significance**."
 
• "Signification" refers to the meaning conveyed by a word or phrase, whereas **"significance"** refers to the importance or value of something.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**underestimate the significance**," ensuring the sentence conveys the intended meaning correctly.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"We should not **underestimate the significance **of female education."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "underestimate at signification"** – This phrase is grammatically incorrect and does not convey the intended meaning.
 
• **Option 3: "underestimate on signification"** – This phrase is also grammatically incorrect and does not convey the intended meaning.
 
• **Option 4: "underestimate signification"** – This phrase is grammatically incorrect as it lacks the necessary article "the" and misuses the word "signification".
